notes.title: Southfield is getting delayed
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Buds,[/h2]

Despite our best efforts, we’ve had to come to the very difficult decision [b]not to release Southfield on June 24th, and delay our launch[/b].

[previewyoutube=K1mX05tqeKM;full][/previewyoutube]

Following our Closed Beta our community gave us great feedback, a recurring problem being performance. In response, we implemented a new way to make the game run more smoothly, which worked well, but created lots of complex issues over the past few weeks.

With a small team, the last thing we want is to put enormous pressure on them to fix these issues for launch and beyond - safeguarding our devs is very important to us. We also don’t want to release a game that isn’t ready.

[b]Southfield doesn’t have a new date yet[/b], and when we find that date we’ll let you know ASAP. This isn’t what we expected to do at such short notice, but we thank you for your support and understanding.

In the meantime, our video does go into some further detail about the reasons behind the performance issues, as well as what we’re currently working on to resolve them.

We’ve also given you a look at some of the many changes and improvements we’ve been able to make since you shared your feedback with us during our Closed Beta. Thank you again for all your comments and suggestions, and for helping our game grow!

[i]Sincerely,
The Southfield Team[/i] 💙

notes.title: Southfield Closed Beta Recap | Team Frog VS Team Axolotl
notes.content:
[h2]What's up, Buds! [/h2]

Over a thousand new Buds joined us in our Closed Beta, and we welcomed back players from our original Next Fest demo. It’s been a pleasure to watch you all wibble and wobble around the Island, building, growing, exploring… and getting up to all kinds of physics-based mischief.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/1d4c16b710880368524eb4a5baf389be69fd9d1d.gif[/img]

We’ve also been absolutely blown away by the positivity and support of our growing community. Our devs worked hard to deliver four separate hotfixes during the beta, and that was made possible due to the dedication of our community, and the high quality detail of their bug reports.

If you visited Southfield in our Closed Beta and want to leave your feedback, please do [url=https://southfieldgame.com/player-feedback-form]fill out our form[/url]. We appreciate all your thoughts, suggestions, and constructive criticisms. It’s how we make our game grow into something great! You can also share your thoughts with us by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/Southfield]community Discord[/url].

[h2][b]Team Frog VS Team Axolotl[/b][/h2]

During our Closed Beta, we challenged our [b]VIB[/b]s (that’s our [b]Very Important Buds[/b]) to compete for points, building, growing, automating and exploring. As our [i]first ever[/i] Creator Cohort, we were so excited to see what they’d get up to, and they did not disappoint!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/a0c272ab34462632421ca510866062615fd6e631.png[/img]

[i][b]Creator Cohort #1:[/b] (Team Frog) [url=https://www.twitch.tv/chaos_n_order]Chaos_n_Order[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@waddlestoddles]WaddlesToddles[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/rhapsperhaps]RhapsPerhaps[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/billietrixx]BillieTrixx[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/geekyn8]GeekyN8[/url], (Team Axolotl) [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lofilondy]lofiLondy[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/janedash]JaneDash[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mistantics]Mistantics[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mama_lumi]Mama_Lumi[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/azurebay]AzureBay[/url][/i]

[h2]🌈 Rainbow Farm[/h2]

We asked our VIBs to colour coordinate their crops, creating a rainbow farm, featuring as many of Southfield’s various vegetation as possible. We had some amazing submissions, and our team whittled it down to two positively perfect veggie patches.

[previewyoutube=qejA27Sq07c;full][/previewyoutube]

Rhaps delivered a truly spectacular farm plot, organised by crop colour! They even included some vibrant trees, all crowned in a perfectly timed rainbow arching over Southfield. We took that as a sign that this submission was a true shiny!

Despite having a few setbacks during beta, Mama_Lumi bounced back like a Boinger crop to create a wonderfully vibrant Rainbow Farm. Lumi was very proud of her accomplishments, and for good reason! Just look at these cute little plots. Such variety and colour, a fantastic effort!

We asked our dev team to vote, and we have a winner...

[h3]🏆 [url=https://www.twitch.tv/rhapsperhaps]RhapsPerhaps[/url] wins the [b]Rainbow Farm[/b] challenge![/h3]

[h2]🏡 Till & Turf[/h2]

We challenged our VIBs to build their Buds a brand new crib during the beta. We loved seeing all the different uses of building materials, and the care our creators took in finding great locations with good views!

[previewyoutube=v9rowAFoBWM;full][/previewyoutube]

Chaos_n_Order opted for a stone and glass combination, with a large glass wall opening out onto the Pleasant Plains – bringing the outside inside! We also loved their use of arched pieces to do something a little different with the upstairs windows (and improve ventilation). The whole build was framed with a quaint little fence, carving out a place to call their own.

JaneDash blew our team away with her elevated home, using the Island’s natural landscape to add height and creating an impressive staircase entrance. Jane also included diamond shaped windows for epic views, balconies and a sky view when Bud needs to snooze under the stars!

And the votes are in...

[h3]🏆 [url=https://www.twitch.tv/janedash]JaneDash[/url] wins the [b]Till & Turf[/b] challenge![/h3]

[h2]🍆 Hurl Your Harvest[/h2]

We wanted to see how far our VIBs could send their Squapples on the longest conveyor belt Southfield has ever seen… and one submission was stand out, hands down, the best and longest conveyor belt ever build in our game!

[previewyoutube=yAly06TQLbc;full][/previewyoutube]

RhapsPerhaps sent their Squapples, boinged their Boingers, and even bounced their Bud for miles. An astounding feat of engineering, 10/10.

[h3]🏆 [url=https://www.twitch.tv/rhapsperhaps]RhapsPerhaps[/url] wins the [b]Hurl Your Harvest[/b] challenge![/h3]

[h2]🖼️ Picture This[/h2]

Our fourth challenge was called “Picture This”, where we asked our VIBs to capture a funny moment from their time playing Southfield in closed beta. Chaos_n_Order delivered with their screenshot aptly named “Praise C4 Tower”, showing their Bud raising their arms in the air while a great towering structure behind them looms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/ba5a3b9ec9884e36f01b1df5171dcfa1a57c32b4.png[/img]

Meanwhile, Mistie was having a very relatable “This Is Fine” moment, with her Axolotl Bud passed out on the floor, on fire, refusing to move. We’ve all been there, right? But there can only be one winner…

[h3]🏆 [url=https://www.twitch.tv/chaos_n_order]Chaos_n_Order[/url] wins the [b]Picture This[/b] challenge![/h3]

[h2]🎬 GIF That Keeps On Giving[/h2]

And finally, we asked our VIBs for a GIF That Keeps On Giving. The challenge? Capture a moment from the beta that best reflects your experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/056c0eb6207d1e37137516f5b16f889618d86c1d.gif[/img]

Lofi_Londy came in strong with a pride-perfect Axolotl stretch beneath a vibrant rainbow, making us feel all warm and fuzzy. Then the explosive submission from WaddlesToddles gave our whole dev team a laugh. Gotta be careful around those Kabume crops!

[h3]🏆 [url=https://www.youtube.com/@waddlestoddles]WaddlesToddles[/url] wins the [b]GIF That Keeps On Giving[/b] challenge![/h3]

[h2]⭐ Honourable Mentions[/h2]
There were so many great submissions that didn't make it into this recap, and some great clips that might not have been part of our five challenges, but gave the whole dev team a good giggle regardless. From Mistie's community creating a compilation of her  [url=https://x.com/SouthfieldGame/status/1795477256078299262]talking about her Boingers[/url], to BillieTrixx noticing that the [url=https://x.com/SouthfieldGame/status/1793238373693329491]seedmaker sounds eerily similar to the Thomas the Tank Engine theme tune[/url]!

Also literally any time one of our VIBs set themselves on fire... Here we have AzureBay accepting her fate having clearly eaten some very spicy vegetables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/48cce2cea8225d2f52409bef90ef4b0e647782c6.png[/img]

[h2]🏆And the winner is... Team Frog! 🐸 [/h2]
Congratulations, [url=https://www.twitch.tv/chaos_n_order]Chaos_n_Order[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@waddlestoddles]WaddlesToddles[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/rhapsperhaps]RhapsPerhaps[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/billietrixx]BillieTrixx[/url], and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/geekyn8]GeekyN8[/url] - with the most amount of points won, Team Frog is taking it home this time!

And a huge well done to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lofilondy]lofiLondy[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/janedash]JaneDash[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mistantics]Mistantics[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mama_lumi]Mama_Lumi[/url], and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/azurebay]AzureBay[/url] of Team Axolotl. In the end, the votes came very close. We enjoyed every stream and every silly clip... And can't wait to see what you get up to next! Both teams will be receiving an in-game medal for their Bud to wear with pride.

[h2]🌱 What's next?[/h2]
We'd love for you to go check out other content from our VIBs, who have been the life force behind our Closed Beta! You can also join in the conversation on our Discord, and be the first to hear about any news and updates.

If you're interested in applying to be in the next Creator Cohort, and join our VIBs in future challenges, you can [url=https://southfieldgame.com/creator-contact-form]apply via the Southfield website[/url] (currently accepting applications).

Thank you again to everyone who joined us for our Closed Beta. As a token of our appreciation, we've created some Southfield wallpapers for you to download (these will be shared in our Discord). We've also added Dancing Bud (see top of post) as a sticker everyone in Discord can use!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/083ac932261894ac51bdad169460cc6fa1a77e97.gif[/img]

We'll also be giving the community a sparkly star sprout to jazz up their Bud come early access, as another little way of saying thank you for playing, and for all your feedback. If you enjoyed our game, please do consider adding us to your wishlist. And as always...

[i]Stay wibbly,
Flop[/i] 💙

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959940/

notes.title: We're extending our Closed Beta
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey, everyone! We're back again with even MORE news![/b][/h3]

I wanted to take a moment to thank you all from me, Flop, the mod team and our devs for exploring the world of Southfield with us for our Closed Beta! The feedback you’ve all given has been super helpful in improving the game as much as we can, and we’ll be working behind the scenes to get everything ready in time for Early Access for you all!

To thank you for all your help, we’ve got some extra special news for you all!
([i]Drumroll please…[/i])

We’re extending the Closed Beta until [b]Monday 3rd June, 4pm BST![/b] You’ll be able to wibble and wobble yourselves through the world of Southfield, all the way through the weekend! You’ll still be able to create content and stream the game up until then too, and we’d absolutely love to see what you end up creating! 

Keep sending your bugs to either the #bug-reporting forum channel, or straight to support.southfieldgame.com and we’ll be gathering them up and sending them to our devs to help improve the game even further!

We also have a small hotfix incoming too, which is mostly just balancing and tweaking based on some of your lovely feedback throughout this beta period!

If you run into any other bugs that aren’t noted in our Known Issues thread, or mentioned in any of our hotfixes, you can go to support.southfieldgame.com to raise a ticket, which will go straight to our team. As usual, if you need to get in touch with us to report a bug not currently on our Known Issues thread, or mentioned in the fixes below, you can visit support.southfieldgame.com to raise a ticket. We also have a dedicated bug reporting forum in our community Discord.

[h3][b]Full patch notes:[/b][/h3]

[/list]
*applicable only to new save files

notes.title: Hotfix | Getting Smoosh Done
notes.content:
[h2]Hey buds, a hotfix has arrived![/h2]

[b]Thanks to everyone who’s left us feedback and flagged bugs over the last 24 hours.[/b] Our devs have been hard at work, optimising and fixing - and we’ve been able to push a patch today to address many of your reports.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/97fc6e53b55386a30effb8dd9e8858bfae7e5823.png[/img]

[h3]💩 [i]Help, I’ve run out of fertiliser![/i][/h3]
We’ve seen a few softlock moments during our tutorial, where the player hasn’t been able to progress as they’ve used up their fertiliser and struggles to find more. We’ve doubled the amount of smoosh and ooze in Baggle’s inventory so you can easily purchase more to complete the quest.

You can also get smoosh by leaving crops on the ground to decay, and ooze spawns around Ruffians at night. Hopefully you won’t run out now!

[h3]💩 [i]Help, the floor ate my items![/i][/h3]
We’ve seen reports that players have found themselves stuck in the ground, and in some cases, the ground has stolen all their items. When this happens, the game will try to force respawn your Bud if you’re unable to get free - and this will automatically revert you to a previous save state.

So, if you didn’t have anything in your inventory at that time, you’ll have an empty inventory when you’ve respawned. We recommend two things…

[olist]
[*] If you get stuck, try to ragdoll your way free, before the game tries to force respawn your Bud.
[*] Manually save regularly, so that if this does happen, it won’t be quite as devastating if some (hopefully less) of your items have gone missing.
[/olist]
To save your game, press “Start”, navigate to the ⚙️ tab at the top, and press “Save Game”.

[h3]💩 [i]Help, I need player support![/i][/h3]
If you need to get in touch with us to report a bug not currently on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2076210/discussions/0/6197594458924895216/]Known Issues thread[/url], or mentioned in the fixes below, you can visit support.southfieldgame.com to raise a ticket. We also have a dedicated bug reporting forum in our community [url=https://discord.gg/Southfield]Discord[/url].

Please be mindful that we are a small team and may not be able to respond to every report, but we’ll keep you posted on any fixes.

[h2]🌱 Full patch notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Smoosh and Ooze into Baggle’s inventory
[*] Moved Smoosh to be an immediate reward before the fertiliser quest
[*] Adjusted the time it takes for crops to grow
[*] Reduced growth time for Boinger crops
[*] Boinger crops now provide more stamina when eaten
[*] Fixed issue where players were not able to reset themselves
[*] Adjusted LOD (level of detail) distances to alleviate popping issues
[*] Changes to music near Vex for less ear ache
[*] Items should no longer be instantly picked up again when dropped
[*] Increased Seedbag production time
[*] Campfires are now lit for increased vibes
[*] Ruffians will now disappear when you clear the Vex corruption zone
[*] Fix for the soil tiles not switching type based on terrain
[*] Some fixes to collision issues
[*] Various UI fixes
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959940/

notes.title: Important Update on Multiplayer in Early Access
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey, Buds![/b][/h3]

We've got an important update from the Southfield team...

Our game has grown so much since the Next Fest demo back in February. We’re excited to show you all the hard work our devs have put into Southfield, with a fresh new Island, more crops, quests, construction options, and customisations.

You’ll soon be able to jump in and start building your own farmstead, meet the locals, and explore the unpredictable Island of Southfield. You’ll discover and grow your own chaotic crops, and invent new ways to automate your harvest.

[h3][b]What's happening with Multiplayer?[/b][/h3]

Growing this game has been a labour of love. And while we’re proud of our journey so far, we know there’s further to go - and we’re grateful to our community for coming along with us.

Southfield was originally conceived as a single-player experience, but as soon as we started playtesting the game, people told us that they would love to share this island with friends. We agree, and that’s why multiplayer has been a part of our roadmap for a while!

However, multiplayer engineering is one of the most complex things to pull off for a relatively small development team, meaning we’ve had to make some pretty tough decisions and one of those is to [b]not include multiplayer at Early Access launch[/b].

Southfield is a game with many moving parts, which are made more complicated by our physics systems. This means that, right now, it’s a real challenge to make multiplayer work and be a fun experience to share with your friends. 

We’re committed to keeping you informed on our progress towards bringing multiplayer to Southfield, and when we have an update, we’ll let you all know via Discord, social media or our Steam community hub.

[h3][b]What's going to be changing right now?[/b][/h3]

Our original Steam store page mentioned multiplayer, and our art for the game also featured multiple Buds. We realise this could be misleading, so we will be removing the additional Buds and mentions of Multiplayer for now.

[h3][b]Southfield Early Access Plans[/b][/h3]

Our Early Access schedule has changed, with [b]Southfield now aiming to leave Early Access sometime in 2025[/b]. Making games is difficult and stressful, but with this extended release plan, the team has more space and time to make Southfield an even richer and evolving single-player experience, and a genuinely fun-filled multiplayer game too!

We have brought some features forward to our Early Access launch to make sure that your first adventure into Southfield is even more jam-packed with ways to play and create, a few of these being:

🌱 [b]The Shovel[/b]
[i]A brand new tool used to gather new resources around the island… oh and you can surf on it, too![/i]

🌱 [b]Multi-resource Construction[/b]
[i]Use the editing mode to take your constructive creations to the next level, with loads more building materials (e.g. glass, brick, etc.)![/i]

🌱 [b]Bombs, Bombs, Bombs[/b]
[i]We have added many more bomb variations so you can discover all manner of explosive gameplay.[/i]

We're focused on making Southfield the best single-player experience we can for launch. We want to make this a place you will want to spend hours in, curating, cultivating and making your home! We want you to be free to explore and create, to meet the Islanders and discover their secrets and quirks.

And we want to know what you think, how you play, and what you love. We want you to come on this journey with us, through Early Access and full release. During that time, we hope to learn a lot, which will help us make sure that when we do launch multiplayer, it will be about sharing all the things you already love, and delivering new ways to play together!

More news to follow soon! And as always, thank you so much for your support.

[i]Stay wibbly,
Flop and the Southfield team! [/i]💙

notes.title: World Art Day | Dev Spotlight
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Buds, look... an art! 👇[/h2]

We’re celebrating [b]World Art Day[/b] by taking a tumble through some cracking concepts, models, and animations from the Southfield art team.

We’ve asked each of them to share a little insight, a peek inside their creative process, to better understand how they brought our Island into being, and gave life to its quirky inhabitants.

[h2]🌄 The Island[/h2]
Rolling hills, winding rivers, and vivid rainbows crown our colourful Island. Southfield instantly feels like a playground paradise to any Bud looking for a fresh beginning! We wanted our world to inspire joy, and so we created a green, happy place where those good feelings could blossom.

Pleasant Plains offers countless perfect locations to build your farmstead. Whether you’re looking to thrive in the Mushroom Valley, escape to the Hilltop Woodlands, or find your peace on The Fens - there’s a dream spot for every Bud! But how did our Island paradise take shape?

Going right back to our roots and the foundations we built on, that cartoonish aesthetic was always there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/e130819223b46b472aee5f349f7cf87552115b9f.jpg[/img]

“The goal of these concepts was to show how different terrain materials combined together in a visually pleasing way,” says Dale, our Senior Concept Artist here at Radical Forge. “Here’s an early concept from when we were trying to figure out the look of Pleasant Plains.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/f8268e953f331eb4e1146cdf8aa95ab307c1ad1c.jpg[/img]

Anyone who caught our last [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2076210]dev update video[/url] will know we’ve recently added arches to the landscape, breaking up the horizon line and drawing the player in, making you want to look up and keep rolling on towards exciting new places to explore.

“The Grasslands is an early exploration of the Pleasant Plains area,” says Andreea, our 2D Artist. “It was inspired by animated movies with strongly stylised shape language and whimsical, nature-focused scenes.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/f9b11e6dd722249844a9075e728df4b2be400fbb.png[/img]

If you played our demo during Next Fest, you’ll have already experienced a little of what Southfield has to offer - and the Island has grown since! Our team has been hard at work perfecting every inch, from large landscape changes to the smallest detail in the Flower Garden.

"The quest board was one of the first assets we made about two years ago” says Jordan, one of our 3D Artists. “I know it seems like a random thing to make first, but it helped us define the art style and pipelines so seeing it in the game with all that came after is a really cool and humbling reflection on where we started and where we’ve ended up.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/654e0a3b54d46c50bf2e89b8c58a7e3f9008ad14.png[/img]

To really take in the Island, you can climb the Watchtowers. “They offer great viewpoints across the Pleasant Plains," Andreea continues. “The Eastern Watchtower has been claimed back by nature.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/457fec0ca608d627ef4b8c264fef704be30aac85.png[/img]

Southfield is as magical as it is mysterious (we’ve even got our own wishing well) but you’ll have to discover that for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/21346f1b38b1f2b3c1bce058ac3ba751e25acb99.png[/img]

[h2]👤 The Islanders[/h2]

The Island is home to some rather unusual inhabitants, each with their own unique style and meticulously designed features. As you meet your new neighbours, you’ll notice they look all too perfect for the job they do.

“It’s definitely handy to be a blacksmith with a portable forge” says Emily, our 3D Character Artist. “A lot of the NPC designs came from a Chimera of their vocations.”

The Islanders all have their own unique personalities. Experts think that over 70% of communication is through body language, and our Junior 3D Animator, Zoe, has paid a great deal of attention to the way each of our NPCs walks, talks and wobbles about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/097ba21ba147f4b31f85650054ad8e82ebd623c8.gif[/img]

Materielle loves to build, and their handy measuring tape belt is a dead giveaway! Gizmo is basically a robot, which checks out since they are all about those gadgets. Still, we’re left wondering why Big Sleeves has such… big sleeves?

"Big Sleeves is the best and it felt great to get to add to their character through a mixture of effects and shader work,” says Piotr, our Junior Technical Artist. “Their scarf is easily one of my favourite vertex animations on the entire project!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/0e13d68f120e5edb98dfbc4a9296f98411a141de.gif[/img]

[h2]🏠 Your Farmstead[/h2]

Speaking of building, when you’ve constructed your house, you’re going to want it to feel like a home too - so we’ve been creating decor to help you bring that cozy vibe to your farmstead!

"The Decor system was super fun to figure out,” Emily explains. “It all works with a gradient atlas system so we can tweak the colours in-engine, quick! We use a second & third UV channel to dictate where those colours and sometimes patterns go!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/726c14ef3f57877f569eec4c531c0405bc8cf824.png[/img]

We’re eager to hear what decor items you’d like to see added to Southfield. [url=https://discord.gg/Southfield]Join our Discord[/url] to share all your ideas and suggestions!

[h2]✨ Island Highlights[/h2]

From cheesy moon rocks to mysterious frog shrines, Southfield has plenty of strange and unusual sights to see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/2fa32346b5b9fe264b04d6fc7a41e35e27dcb4b7.png[/img]

"Set dressing the moon pools, graveyard and mushroom forest were so fun,” says Mara, our Environmental Artist. “They're just such calm and relaxing areas during the day, but have such interesting colour changes at night to create a more magical area to explore.”

“I hope players have as much fun running around and exploring these zones as I did dressing them!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/912d96abb8fbd53398698e3bc54501955ea9be1d.png[/img]

[h2]🌱 Thanks for your support![/h2]

And we all hope you have as much fun playing as we’ve had making Southfield. The work continues as we head towards Early Access. We’re excited to see how our Island grows with our community, and we invite you to join us!

Please consider adding Southfield to your wishlist, and joining our Discord to hear all the latest news, share your ideas, and see more from our team.

[i]Stay wibbly![/i] 💙

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076210/Southfield/

notes.title: Community Update | Demo VS Now
notes.content:
[h2]🎬 New dev update video![/h2]

In this quick community update, we take a sneak peek at the new Island, from concept art to in-game landscaping and detailing, and we discuss how your feedback from our Next Fest demo has been implemented.

The Island of Southfield has changed a lot since our demo. A quick glance at the horizon and you’ll see new things… just everywhere! From mushrooms that glow in the dark, to waterfalls and winding rivers dividing the Island, Southfield feels entirely new (because it is).

[previewyoutube=D2nNREfFXf0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Video Highlights[/h2]
🌱  Upgraded Island (featuring ARCHES)
🌱  Windmills, waterfalls and rivers
🌱  The mushrooms GLOW IN THE DARK
🌱  Reveal: Crop Combiner (new machine)
🌱  Bud can eat crops now (but should they?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/c78688bb945a4e80a9e7eabd50bdd62b90c0c1ca.gif[/img]

[h2]📝 Player Feedback[/h2]

Thanks to everyone who left us feedback when playing during our Next Fest demo period. All your comments were reviewed by our team, and we've been able to make changes and improvements based on your shared experiences.

👉 [b]Camera movement sensitivity and motion sickness[/b]
The FPS drops and erratic camera movement definitely did not help things when it comes to motion sickness, but we’ve made improvements to the camera movement, and our options menu so you’ll have much more control over your experience. We’ve also improved our vehicles, with a directionally tied camera to reduce that floaty feeling when driving, and hopefully reducing triggers for motion sickness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/09cb75bd64c399051cc229f09511f1696821ee5c.gif[/img]

👉 [b]Respawning vehicles on the go[/b]
It kinda sucks when you get your ride stuck on some particularly pointy rocks, or you happen to drive into a lake. We’ve now made the vehicle spawn platform portable, so you can respawn your ride wherever you are. All you have to do is hit it with an axe, and put it in your pocket.

👉 [b]UI improvements to machines[/b]
We’re continuously working to improve our UI, and this has recently looked like improved communication for how to use machines (which proved an issue for some demo players). We’ve also made ALL machines interactable by either approaching and pressing a button, or the tried and trusted “lob it in” method.

👉 [b]UI prompt to find Almanac[/b]
Players were also struggling to find the Almanac in our demo. We’ve now added a UI prompt so that every time you find a new crop, you’ll be able to jump straight to the Almanac and track your discovery.

👉 [b]Control NPC volume[/b]
Players wanted to control NPC dialogue volume. We’ve added this so you can tweak it to your liking, and we’re continuing to look at ways to improve chatting with NPCs based on your feedback.

👉 [b]Better balance to soundtrack[/b]
Players commented on the odd silences where there was just no music playing in the demo. We go deeper into our goals for the Southfield soundtrack in our dev update video. While the game will have more tracks and ambient sounds than the demo did, we still appreciate silent moments can be a problem for streamers who are relying on our music (and while this won't necessarily be added in Early Access, we're happy to add a setting so you can control the frequency in which music is played)!

[h2]✨ Axolotl Outfit Reveal ✨[/h2]
We reveal our little pink Axolotl onesie in the dev update, but we've also been working to ensure a lot of our skins have plenty of colour variants to choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/fa83a504d5c21f367243b263eb044afb06785460.png[/img]

[h2]📢 Community Shoutouts[/h2]

Our very own Rhaps (a VIB and valued Discord moderator) kindly created this adorable emoji and sticker for our community, in celebration of the axolotl outfit reveal. Why not [url=https://discord.gg/Southfield]pop by our server[/url] and do a little flap?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/af2158f8e54ae15e2a4a1578ce3a7e8ac9982b84.gif[/img]

That's all for now!

[i]Stay wibbly,
Flop [/i]💙

notes.title: Southfield | Hotfix | Demo Performance Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Big news, buds![/h2]

Flop here, I come bearing some good news! We've pushed a hotfix, in the hopes we can reduce some of the performance issues players of our demo have been reporting... and just in time for the weekend!

I wanted to give you a quick run down of what we've been working on. We are limited to what we can do right now, and optimisation takes time. Still, we're confident this will help people experiencing crashes on launch, and generally make the demo experience a bit smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/ac5836f3e512890aec06b6ba8e7c51822ac6cef1.png[/img]

[h3]⭐ Lag at launch/crash[/h3]
Players have reported a lot of lag when launching the demo. Provided you are playing above the minimum spec, this should be fixed! If you're closer to minimum spec. than recommended, we'd still suggest giving the demo a minute to warm up.

[h3]⭐ Day/Night transition lag[/h3]
The lag reported when transitioning from day to night should be minimised, while the lag transitioning from night to day should be fixed. The lag players have been experiencing between 9pm and 6am in-game has been improved but is still apparent.

[h3]⭐ Additional changes[/h3]
We've made some adjustments to the tutorial as some players were getting confused about the quest to fix up the house for Grumps. It should be a bit more obvious now what to do! We've also added a stone cutter outside the farm for flips and giggles.

We just want to thank everyone who's taken the time to leave feedback. You've been patient with us, and that's not gone unnoticed. We all really appreciate your support, the constructive criticism, the bug reports - and the recognition that this is a demo. It's a work in progress, and just a flavour of what Southfield is going to become.

Thank you for that.

[i]Stay wibbly,
Flop[/i] 💙

notes.title: Play Southfield Demo | Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Buds![/h2]

It's finally time to visit Southfield - our demo is available to play! Here's just a few things you need to know before you get started...

This demo gives you a flavour of what's to come. There's plenty to dig into, with quirky islanders to meet, quests to complete, crops to harvest for seeds, and the ability to build your very own farmstead. You'll be growing in no time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/8ae7da1908c95281ac5b6aeef6c7625f47eb977a.png[/img]

[h3]🌱 [b]Bug Reporting & Player Support[/b] 🌱[/h3]

But this is still just a demo, right? So, we're expecting there to be bugs. And we want to make you aware of our process for bug reporting and accessing player support.

We've detailed all the key issues we think you might stumble across in our Known Issues thread (available on the Steam Discussion Board or in our [url=https://discord.gg/T5EcVs3j5S]Discord community server[/url]).

Reporting a bug is easy enough! Feel free to pop it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2076210/discussions/0/4209245670465724113/]Bug Megathread[/url] over on the Discussion Board, or consider joining us on Discord for quick and easy troubleshooting. It'd be super helpful for us if you could include some basic information, like your PC specs and (if possible) reproduction steps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/e6eb808413955be888c67d319809a149f536c2df.png[/img]

[i]Please be aware that we are a small UK-based studio, monitoring channels from 9am to 5pm, Monday to Friday, so there may be a delay in getting back to you.[/i]

[h3]🌱 [b]Saving in Southfield[/b] 🌱[/h3]

We also wanted to let you know that [b]the save function in the Southfield demo has been disabled[/b]. We know this might be frustrating, especially for players who want to save and come back for more - but despite our best efforts, the save feature was causing too many issues when reloading the game, and we decided to turn it off for a less buggy experience.

Still, we'll be into Early Access before you know it. The Island is already changing so much, it'll feel like a fresh start with so much more to explore. And you can help shape the Southfield of the future!

[h3]🌱 [b]Joining the Community[/b] 🌱[/h3]

We chose to release Southfield as an Early Access game because we want you to be a part of our development process. Southfield is already alive and thriving, ready to welcome you - but this is a journey, and your feedback, ideas and support will help our Island (and our game) grow!

Thank you for playing our demo. Let us know what you think! All ideas, suggestions and feedback is welcome. Please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076210/Southfield/]wishlist our game[/url] to be notified about news and events (and to make our day, obvs)!

[i]Keep rollin’

The Southfield Team[/i] 💙

notes.title: Announcing Southfield
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Buds![/h2]

We’re practically falling over with excitement, because the time has come for us to announce [b]Southfield[/b] - a silly, physics-based farming game by Radical Forge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789583/ecd46daa1af992fa729f1895f346e61d600fb938.gif[/img]

We’ll be inviting you to play our demo [i]very soon[/i]! You’ll be able to get stuck in, building your dream farmstead, growing and harvesting unpredictable crops, and dramatically flinging yourself around the colourful, chaotic world of Southfield.

During [b]Early Access[/b], we want to make sure Southfield grows into the Island you want to see. We’ve got plenty of ideas (and we plan to share our roadmap!), but we’re eager to hear your thoughts too.

We’ve opened up our [url=https://discord.gg/T5EcVs3j5S]Discord community server[/url], where our players will be able to leave feedback, engage in discussions around changes and improvements, and access exclusive content. Please consider joining us there!
